name: al-spec
description: ALSpec independent DR, Story, and TestCase SKILLs, each with embedded writing rules and a mandatory template context, plus global/project registry support.

interface.longDescription: ALSpec currently defines three independent specification types: DR, Story, and TestCase. Each type SKILL is its own writing specification and requires its canonical template as context. Project-level SKILLs add exact adaptations without imposing upstream or downstream dependencies. PRD and CodingPlan are reserved for a later scope expansion.
capabilities: Embedded writing rules with mandatory template loading
defaultPrompt: Use the matching al-spec type SKILL to create a DR, Story, or TestCase; load its mandatory template context.
Use the matching al-spec type SKILL to review a specification for completeness and evidence.
When the repository has a confirmed project ID, also load the exact project-level type SKILL and its required template.
